_comment: DoorDash / Uber Eats affiliate catalog feeds (Impact-style). Each feed is SKIPPED while its ${ENV_VAR} is unset, so this is a silent no-op until the affiliate programs approve the account and the repo secrets are set (DOORDASH_FEED_URL / UBEREATS_FEED_URL = the signed catalog download URL from the network dashboard). 'map' translates that catalog's column names - adjust to the real export headers on first run. Caps are deliberate: Impact catalogs can carry 100k+ rows; raise max_locations consciously, per market.
